title: timezonedefinition
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby.

bias.description: Base time bias of the time zone.

createdon.description: Date and time when the time zone record was created.

daylightname.description: Time zone name for the daylight time.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the time zone record was modified.

retiredorder.description: Order an entry for a time zone definition is retired.

standardname.description: Time zone name for the standard time.

timezonedefinitionid.description: Unique identifier of the time zone record.

userinterfacename.description: Display name for the time zone in the Microsoft Windows registry.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the time zone record.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the timezonedefinition.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who last modified the time zone record.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who last modified the timezonedefinition.
